title: multi_instance.rs: Eq reflexivity not enforced for NaN in RootCandidate
description:
P3 ROBUSTNESS: RootCandidate has public fields rssi_ema/snr_ema (f32) and implements Eq. Direct struct construction can set NaN values, violating Eq reflexivity (NaN != NaN). The builder methods sanitize NaN to defaults, but direct initialization allows:
```rust
RootCandidate { rssi_ema: f32::NAN, snr_ema: f32::NAN, ... }
```
This could cause subtle bugs in HashSet/HashMap operations.

Options:
- Make fields private (requires API change)
- Add debug_assert in struct methods
- Document as known limitation (already documented at line 908-909)

File: rust/lichen-rpl/src/multi_instance.rs
Line: 974

Discovered by: 3x codereview (edge-cases pass)
